data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'melissa', meaning 'honey bee'. In Christian symbolism, bees represent the labor and industry of the early Christian monastic communities. A gracious and majestic name for a girl. The name Mellicent carries the meaning “Majestic, Gracious” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Mellicent usually hope their child will grow to embody majestic, gracious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes dedication, hard work, and community.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mellicent total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
